versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בְּיוֹם־הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
controles.livre: No primeiro dia do mês primeiro farás levantar o tabernáculo, o tabernáculo do testemunho:

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

controles.web: You shall put the ark of the testimony in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
controles.livre: E porás nele a arca do testemunho, e a cobrirás com o véu:

versos.hebraico: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
controles.livre: E meterás a mesa, e a porás em ordem: meterás também o candelabro e acenderás suas lâmpadas:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E porás o altar de ouro para o incenso diante da arca do testemunho, e porás a cortina diante da porta do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
controles.livre: Depois porás o altar do holocausto diante da porta do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
controles.livre: Logo porás a pia entre o tabernáculo do testemunho e o altar; e porás água nela.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃

controles.web: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
controles.livre: Finalmente porás o átrio em derredor, e a cortina da porta do átrio.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture: and it will be holy.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
controles.livre: E tomarás o azeite da unção e ungirás o tabernáculo, e tudo o que está nele; e lhe santificarás com todos os seus utensílios, e será santo.

versos.hebraico: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar: and the altar will be most holy.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
controles.livre: Ungirás também o altar do holocausto e todos os seus utensílios: e santificarás o altar, e será um altar santíssimo.

versos.hebraico: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
controles.livre: Também ungirás a pia e sua base, e a santificarás.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
controles.livre: E farás chegar a Arão e a seus filhos à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e os lavarás com água.

versos.hebraico: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

controles.web: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
controles.livre: E farás vestir a Arão as vestimentas sagradas, e o ungirás, e o consagrarás, para que seja meu sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃

controles.web: You shall bring his sons, and put coats on them.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
controles.livre: Depois farás chegar seus filhos, e lhes vestirás as túnicas:

versos.hebraico: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֨חְתָּ֙ אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
controles.livre: E os ungirás como ungiste a seu pai, e serão meus sacerdotes: e será que sua unção lhes servirá por sacerdócio perpétuo por suas gerações.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס

controles.web: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
controles.kjv: Thus did Moses: according to all that the Lord commanded him, so did he.
controles.livre: E Moisés fez conforme tudo o que o SENHOR lhe mandou; assim o fez.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
controles.livre: E assim no dia primeiro do primeiro mês, no segundo ano, o tabernáculo foi erigido.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־עַמּוּדָֽיו׃

controles.web: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
controles.kjv: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
controles.livre: E Moisés fez levantar o tabernáculo, e assentou suas bases, e colocou suas tábuas, e pôs suas barras, e fez erguer suas colunas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־הָאֹ֨הֶל֙ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E estendeu a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e pôs a cobertura encima do mesmo; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

controles.web: He took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
controles.kjv: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
controles.livre: E tomou e pôs o testemunho dentro da arca, e colocou as varas na arca, e encima o propiciatório sobre a arca:

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E meteu a arca no tabernáculo, e pôs o véu da tenda, e cobriu a arca do testemunho; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

controles.web: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside of the veil.
controles.kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
controles.livre: E pôs a mesa no tabernáculo do testemunho, ao lado norte da cortina, fora do véu:

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E sobre ela pôs por ordem os pães diante do SENHOR, como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה׃

controles.web: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
controles.kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
controles.livre: E pôs o candelabro no tabernáculo do testemunho, em frente da mesa, ao lado sul da cortina.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E acendeu as lâmpadas diante do SENHOR; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

controles.web: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
controles.kjv: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
controles.livre: Pôs também o altar de ouro no tabernáculo do testemunho, diante do véu:

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: and he burnt incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E acendeu sobre ele o incenso aromático; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
controles.livre: Pôs também a cortina da porta do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E colocou o altar do holocausto à porta do tabernáculo, do tabernáculo do testemunho; e ofereceu sobre ele holocausto e presente; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃

controles.web: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
controles.kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
controles.livre: E pôs a pia entre o tabernáculo do testemunho e o altar; e pôs nela água para lavar.

versos.hebraico: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
controles.livre: E Moisés e Arão e seus filhos lavavam nela suas mãos e seus pés.

versos.hebraico: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Quando entravam no tabernáculo do testemunho, e quando se traziam ao altar, se lavavam; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃פ

controles.web: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
controles.kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
controles.livre: Finalmente erigiu o átrio em derredor do tabernáculo e do altar, e pôs a cortina da porta do átrio. E assim acabou Moisés a obra.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
controles.livre: Então uma nuvem cobriu o tabernáculo do testemunho, e a glória do SENHOR encheu o tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E não podia Moisés entrar no tabernáculo do testemunho, porque a nuvem estava sobre ele, e a glória do SENHOR o tinha enchido.

versos.hebraico: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
controles.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
controles.livre: E quando a nuvem se erguia do tabernáculo, os filhos de Israel se moviam em todas suas jornadas:

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
controles.kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
controles.livre: Porém se a nuvem não se erguia, não se partiam até o dia em que ela se erguia.

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
controles.kjv: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
controles.livre: Porque a nuvem do SENHOR estava de dia sobre o tabernáculo, e o fogo estava de noite nele, à vista de toda a casa de Israel, em todas as suas jornadas.
